mapper.insert: insert into product_all (product_name, product_content, product_category, product_count, product_reg_date, price, shortDescription, saved_file_name, original_file_name, img_url, seller_id) values (#{productName}, #{productContent}, #{productCategory}, #{productCount}, #{productRegDate}, #{price}, #{shortDescription}, #{savedFileName}, #{originalFileName}, #{imgUrl}, #{sellerId})
